description: This file defines the ReadWriteLock class, which implements a read-write lock mechanism using internal state management and synchronization primitives. It provides methods for acquiring and releasing read and write locks, ensuring thread-safe access to shared resources.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock
classes.description: A class providing thread-safe read-write locking mechanism, allowing multiple concurrent readers or exclusive writers.

methods.name: ReadWriteLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock state to IDLE and reader count to zero.

methods.name: ~ReadWriteLock
methods.description: Destructor asserting that no readers are active and the lock is idle.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a read lock, waiting up to the specified wait time.

methods.name: ReadUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired read lock.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a write lock, waiting up to the specified wait time.

methods.name: WriteUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired write lock.
